description: This file defines the ContentLanguageSettings entity class for Drupal, including its properties, constructor, and methods for managing content language configurations within the Drupal CMS.

classes.name: ContentLanguageSettings
classes.description: Defines the configuration entity for content language settings, including properties for entity type, bundle, default language, and methods for managing these settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a ContentLanguageSettings object, requiring target entity type ID and bundle, with validation.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier combining target entity type ID and bundle.

methods.name: getTargetEntityTypeId
methods.description: Returns the target entity type ID.

methods.name: setLanguageAlterable
methods.description: Sets whether the language is alterable.

methods.name: isLanguageAlterable
methods.description: Checks if the language is alterable.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Pre-save hook to set the entity ID.

methods.name: isDefaultConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if the configuration is default.

methods.name: loadByEntityTypeBundle
methods.description: Loads a configuration entity based on entity type and bundle, creating a new one if none exists.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates dependencies for the entity, including bundle dependencies.

methods.name: getAllValidDefaultLangcodes
methods.description: Returns all valid default language codes, including special codes.
